blocks.text: Once Banda submits, the Guru commissions him toward action, telling him to punish Sirhind, avenge the Sahibzadas, protect the Sikhs, and shake hostile power from Delhi outward.
The mission is not vague exhortation: the Guru arms Banda, gives him visible tokens of command, and frames the struggle as a righteous campaign against those who murdered innocents.
With that charge, Banda ceases to be merely a penitent ascetic and becomes an instrument of vengeance against Sirhind under the Guru’s command.
